comment: A course offered at a specific campus.

columns.name: campus_id
columns.comment: Campus this course is offered at.

columns.name: id
columns.comment: Surrogate identifier for the course, auto-generated by the database.

columns.name: course_type
columns.comment: How this course is delivered (e.g. In Person, Online) -- references course_type.code.

columns.name: course_number
columns.comment: Human-readable course code, unique within its campus (the same code may be reused at a different campus).

columns.name: description
columns.comment: Optional free-text description of the course.
